title: Linux runner VM killed by host memory limit

model.rawSql:
SELECT json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'instance') AS instance, count(*) AS value
FROM opentelemetry_logs
WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
  AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
  AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'integrations/kubernetes/journal'
  AND body LIKE '%Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process%'
  AND body LIKE '%(qemu-system-%'
GROUP BY 1

annotations.summary: Host OOM killer stopped {{ $values.A.Value }} runner VM(s) on {{ $labels.instance }} in ten minutes
annotations.description: The host kernel killed a Kata runner VM's QEMU because the Pod's memory cgroup was full. The guest never sees an OOM and the job ends as GitHub's "runner lost communication". Zero is normal; any kill means a Pod-level memory limit is smaller than the VM it holds.
